findings.old_behavior: When the --clustered option is used without VG arguments and without --yes, vgchange prompts the user with the text 'Change clustered property of all volumes groups? [y/n]: ' (note the incorrect plural 'volumes groups').
findings.new_behavior: After the patch, the prompt text reads 'Change clustered property of all volume groups? [y/n]: ' (corrected to 'volume groups'). The rest of the behavior is identical.
findings.compatibility_reason: The user-visible prompt text has changed by one word ('volumes' -> 'volume'). This is a grammar fix that corrects the prompt string. Any test or automation that asserts on the exact prompt text 'volumes groups' would fail, though such tests are extremely unlikely given this is an interactive yes_no_prompt typically bypassed via --yes.

evidence.snippet: (yes_no_prompt("Change clustered property of all volume groups? [y/n]: ") == 'n')) {

findings.why_not_internal_only: The prompt text is user-facing CLI output shown to any user running 'vgchange --clustered' without --yes. It is part of the interactive CLI surface of the lvm2 tools.
findings.uncertainty: Low uncertainty about the text change itself. Moderate uncertainty about whether this qualifies as a 'compatibility' issue since it is a grammar fix in an interactive prompt that is not machine-parsed. The change has no behavioral impact.
findings.recommended_review: No manual review needed. The change is a straightforward typo fix in a user-facing prompt.
findings.test_recommendation: Low-priority test: verify the corrected prompt text appears when running 'vgchange --clustered' without --yes and providing 'n' as input. Test via piping 'n' to the command and capturing stderr/stdout for the expected string.
